purpose: Source-verified direct wild feeding observations for Testudo graeca ibera. This ledger preserves taxon, plant identity scope, plant part, study setting, and inference boundaries before canonical food-level integration.

sources.citation: Iftime A, Iftime O. Long term observations on the alimentation of wild Eastern Greek Tortoises Testudo graeca ibera in Dobrogea, Romania. Acta Herpetologica. 2012;7(1):105-110.
sources.sample_context: more than 500 wild specimens observed from March to October over 10 years
supports: 96.5% of observed feeding cases involved plant matter
25 plant species were recorded as consumed
young leaves were preferentially ingested for several listed plant groups
does_not_support: a captive diet percentage for any individual plant
daily or unlimited feeding of any observed plant
exact-species evidence when the source identifies only a genus or family

sources.citation: Mitrevichin E, Sakelarieva L, Peshev H, Pulev A. Notes on the diet of Testudo hermanni boettgeri and T. graeca ibera in south-western Bulgaria with first cases of geophagy and myrmecophagy from the country. ZooNotes. 2023;228:1-4.
sources.location: Kresna Gorge and adjacent areas, south-western Bulgaria
sources.method: direct wild observation; photographs used for food identification when possible
sources.sample_context: 309 T. graeca observed; 17 registered T. graeca food-consumption cases; plants could not be identified in about half of all feeding observations across both tortoise species
supports: T. graeca feeding observations in this study were exclusively plant-based
identified T. graeca foods included Cichorium intybus, Sedum rubens, Sedum album, Potentilla sp., Taraxacum sp., and Medicago sp.
does_not_support: population-wide diet percentages for individual plants
using Sedum rubens or Sedum album as exact-species evidence for Sedum sarmentosum
using Taraxacum sp. or Medicago sp. as exact-species evidence
